APSIMModelDesign.supported_architecture: Models are ordinary .NET classes, dependencies are explicit links/interfaces, simulation lifecycle is event driven, and initialization is serializable.
APSIMModelDesign.use_limit: Architecture reference only; does not establish biological validity, calibration quality or equivalence to APSIM maturity.

PCSEReferenceGuide.supported_architecture: A dedicated engine orders weather, management, rate and state operations. SimulationObjects separate initialization, rate calculation and integration, with read-only parameters and controlled state/rate mutation.
PCSEReferenceGuide.use_limit: Architecture reference only; does not establish biological validity, parameter identification or WOFOST-equivalent maturity.
